problems.title: Interleave Iterator with Cycle

source.preview_scope: group-level; not a complete variant specification

inference_basis_fields: contentPreview: round-robin interleaving iterator over integer arrays with a cycle flag
problems.inferred_spec: Class InterleaveIterator(arrays, cycle). Elements are produced round-robin: element 0 of each array in array order, then element 1 of each array that has one, and so on; exhausted and empty arrays are skipped. With cycle false the iterator ends after one pass. With cycle true the whole interleaved sequence restarts from the beginning after it is exhausted, forever, unless there are no elements at all. hasNext() reports whether next() would produce a value; next() returns the next value, or null when none is available (inference).
problems.inference_uncertainty: high: the preview stops before describing the cycle behaviour; whole-sequence restart (rather than per-array wrap-around), the method names and the null return when exhausted are inferred
